verdict.rationale: Mercury documents scoped/least-privilege credential issuance for agents: read-only, read-write, and custom API tokens (mercury-docs-35), 'Issue scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions' (mercury-docs-20), OAuth2 authorization flows (mercury-docs-15), and dashboard-based revocation (mercury-docs-25). This is independently corroborated by a live probe of the hosted MCP server showing OAuth2/PKCE-gated access with explicit granular scopes (read, offline_access) and a read-only-only tool inventory (mercury-probe-4, mercury-probe-5), confirming scoped agent credentials work in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of actually minting a 'custom' scoped token end-to-end and assigning it to a live agent workflow.
